name: Sheet Pan Orange-Hoisin Tofu with Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Sesame
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet along with broccoli. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice oranges into a medium bowl. Add hoisin sauce and additional oil, then stir to combine.
Medium dice tofu. Add to the bowl with the sauce and stir to coat.
When the veggies have started to soften, remove from the oven. Add tofu and sauce to the baking sheet; stir to combine with the veggies, then spread out in an even layer.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until veggies are tender and tofu is warmed through, 7-8 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide tofu-veggie bake between plates or bowls and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
